note: One structure for every page's positioning (Decisions Log row 39). Modelled on the Token Factory context pack. The drafter must follow it; code checks it (agent/page_setup.py check_positioning); the console will not accept an approval while a check fails. Edit this file to change the rule for all pages.
bullet_rule: Every bullet ends with [source ids | LABEL]. Source ids are claim ids (CL-), evidence ids (EV-), source register ids (SRC-), library ids (LIB-), buyer rows (BR-), a rules/ file or a project file path. LABEL is one or more of the allowed labels, separated by commas.
promise_rule: Section 1 holds one line: Promise, exact words: "...". At most 30 words. It must not restate the live hero (more than 60% shared words fails).
market_signal_rule: A market signal shows demand for a kind of product. It is never proof about Sarvam. Each section 8 bullet starts with 'Market signal.' or 'Reading:'.

sections.heading: Positioning promise
sections.must_cover: the promise in exact words; the page message to test (headline and support, PROPOSED); the proposed advantage and what it is NOT a lead in

sections.heading: Category and first purchase
sections.must_cover: the category in plain words and what it is not; the first purchase a buyer makes; the commercial unit; any hard word defined once

sections.heading: Primary audience and trigger
sections.must_cover: the primary buyer; the event that makes them look now; any conflict between research files, kept visible

sections.heading: Supporting audiences and what each must see
sections.must_cover: each buying-committee role and what the page must show them; each role's main objection

sections.heading: The real alternatives and what beats each
sections.must_cover: doing nothing or the current way; direct rivals; build in-house; what would beat each, as a test, not a claim

sections.heading: Rival gaps from the UI/UX audit
sections.must_cover: what rival pages show that this page does not, and the strengths to keep; a missing rival feature does not prove the rival lacks it

sections.heading: What the position does NOT claim
sections.must_cover: claims that are not exclusive, not proven or banned (rules/do-not-claim.md)

sections.heading: Market signals (not proof about Sarvam)
sections.must_cover: demand signals with exact quotes and dates, then one Reading: line

sections.heading: Proof Sarvam has (claim ids) and proof missing
sections.must_cover: every hero-usable fact with its claim id; the proof that is missing

sections.heading: What happens after the main CTA
sections.must_cover: the real next step behind the main button, or UNKNOWN

sections.heading: Headline angles that failed or were rejected
sections.must_cover: angles set aside and why (swap test, no proof, banned word)

sections.heading: Open gaps
sections.must_cover: what a person must find or decide before the page can say more
